name: Paradise Ocean
source:
This is the debut game for PIXEL MINT. “Paradise Ocean” is a cruise ship that sails across the sparkling blue seas with a school aboard. New students jumped on the chance to have a taste of a luxurious cruise for a low tuition. However, there’s no free lunch in this world. In order to pay off their school and living expenses, they are forced to work as the ship’s crew! Trapped in despair from the outside world, they have to rely on each other to have a glimmer of hope.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/03/15/march-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri[/url]]
translation:
这是PIXEL MINT的处女作。“Paradise Ocean”是一艘航行在闪耀蓝色海洋上的邮轮，船上还设有学校。新生们抓住机会，以低廉学费体验豪华邮轮生活。然而，世上没有免费的午餐。为了偿还学费和生活费，他们被迫担任船员！被困在与外界隔绝的绝望之中，他们只能互相依靠，寻找一丝希望。

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/03/15/march-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri[/url]）
